title: 第二十三章 骑士之路勤奋的天才第二十四章 暗潮漩涡潮汐十字剑
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: “啊？”伊芙明显愣了一下。
下一刻，她原本白皙的面庞突然红了一瞬。
的确，刚刚她在涂抹药剂的时候出现了一瞬间的分心。
“没……”伊芙没想到李奥的学习能力这么强，竟然只一遍便完全记住了气律。
而且还他发现了只慢了一瞬间的节奏。
不过此时的她自然不可能承认。
不专业，太不专业了。
伊芙没想过她活了十八年，竟然会在一个小侍童的面前出了洋相。
不过她脑子转的很快，迅速清了清嗓子，“咳咳，其实作为第一次学习，你的表现已经很不错了。其实是你的气律节奏乱了一下。
不要紧，气律节奏乱了会浪费一些淬体药剂。不过没关系，只要不是用错了气律，就没有什么大的影响。”
伊芙一口气解释了一大段，此时心绪好像平复了一些，“好，就这样吧，我看你已经掌握了基本的方法，接下来就是不停的练习，直到这呼吸法成为自己的本能。
这里面最关键的还是这淬体药剂，这东西产量有限，所以尽量保持气律平稳，不要浪费。
另外，记得多补充肉食，最好是兽人肉，那是你身体强壮的基础。”
这伊芙可向来都是少言寡语，一副牛逼哄哄的高人姿态。
刚刚她却像是爆豆子般噼里啪啦突然说了这么一大堆。
明显是被自己说中了。
李奥此时整理着伊芙刚刚介绍的内容。
伊芙刚刚介绍的是呼吸法的练习方法。
如果类比于前世健身。
那么这淬体药水像是兴奋剂，或者是激素。
呼吸法相当于是撸铁的方法。
而肉食则是高蛋白食物。
三者缺一不可。
想到这里，李奥心中明朗了一些。
看着准备离开的伊芙，他突然想起了一个更加重要的事。
他赶紧叫住对方，“老师，您说的进阶剑法……还没教我呢。”
李奥感觉这个便宜老师有点不靠谱。
不赶紧叫住她搞不好又突然消失，那么自己的剑法岂不是泡汤了。
“哦，对，剑法，我现在正要去拿剑。”伊芙明显是忘了，此时连忙找补。
但她脚步不停，很快到了门口。
“您的剑……”李奥看着自己腰间挂着的那把星陨，刚想说，伊芙已经跑远了。
李奥收敛心神，此时再次念诵气律，感受自己的呼吸节奏，‘刚刚属于靠着短时记忆死记硬背下来的，时间一长可能就会遗忘，得趁热打铁把这种呼吸方式熟练，完全固化为肌肉本能。’
李奥想着，闭上了眼睛。
他开始屏气凝神，重复刚才的呼吸方式。
在气律的辅助下，李奥很快找到了那股控制力量运转的节奏。
好像是将空气中某种能量因子吸收到体内，形成循环，淬炼自身体魄的过程。
呼吸法很玄，李奥尝试以自己的方式去理解。
感觉着体内能量在呼吸辅助下缓缓流动。
李奥没有注意到的是，就在刚刚，他的口鼻处溢出了一缕极淡的灰气。
但他注意到的是，自己的面板之中此时已经是出现了一个新的一栏。
【呼吸法：熔炉呼吸法第一阶段1100】
“竟然入门了！”门口传来了伊芙的惊呼声。
李奥没注意，伊芙却是注意到了李奥的灰气。
content_en:
"Huh?" Eve was obviously stunned for a moment.
The next moment, her originally fair face suddenly turned red.
Indeed, she was momentarily distracted while applying the potion.
"No..." Eve didn't expect that Leo's learning ability was so strong, that he could completely memorize the Qi Law in just one time.
And he also discovered that the rhythm was only a moment slower.
But it was naturally impossible for her to admit it at this time.
Unprofessional, so unprofessional.
Eve never thought that after living for eighteen years, she would make a fool of herself in front of a little waiter.
However, her mind was spinning quickly and she quickly cleared her throat, "Ahem, actually, as this is your first time learning, your performance is already very good. In fact, your breathing rhythm is a little messed up.
It doesn't matter, if the Qi rhythm is messed up, some body tempering potion will be wasted. But it doesn't matter. As long as you don't use the wrong Qi rhythm, there won't be any big impact. "
Eve explained a long paragraph in one breath, and her mood seemed to have calmed down a bit at this time, "Okay, that's it. I think you have mastered the basic method. The next step is to keep practicing until this breathing method becomes your own instinct.
The most critical thing here is the body tempering potion. The output of this thing is limited, so try to keep the gas rhythm stable and don't waste it.
In addition, remember to add more meat, preferably orc meat, which is the basis for your physical strength. "
This Eve has always been a man of few words, with a arrogant and coaxing attitude.
Just now, she suddenly said so much like popping beans.
It was obvious that he was right.
Leo was currently sorting out what Eve had just introduced.
What Eve just introduced is the breathing method.
If compared to fitness in previous lives.
So this body tempering potion is like a stimulant, or a hormone.
The breathing method is equivalent to the method of rolling iron.
Meat is a high-protein food.
All three are indispensable.
Thinking of this, Leo felt a little clearer.
Looking at Eve who was about to leave, he suddenly remembered a more important thing.
He quickly stopped the other party, "Teacher, the advanced swordsmanship you mentioned... you haven't taught me yet."
Leo felt that this cheap teacher was a bit unreliable.
If he didn't call her out quickly, she might suddenly disappear again, and his swordsmanship would be ruined.
"Oh, yes, swordsmanship. I'm going to get the sword now." Eve obviously forgot and quickly made up for it.
But she kept walking and soon reached the door.
"Your sword..." Leo looked at the Xingyun hanging on his waist and was about to say that Eve had already run away.
Leo gathered his mind and recited Qi Rhythm again at this time, feeling his own breathing rhythm. "I just relied on short-term memory to memorize it by rote. It may be forgotten as time goes by. I have to strike while the iron is hot to become proficient in this breathing method and completely solidify it into muscle instinct." ’
Leo thought and closed his eyes.
He began to hold his breath and repeat the breathing pattern just now.
With the help of Qi Lv, Leo quickly found the rhythm of controlling the movement of power.
It seems to be a process of absorbing certain energy factors in the air into the body, forming a circulation, and tempering one's body.
The breathing method is very mysterious, and Leo tried to understand it in his own way.
Feel the energy in your body flowing slowly with the help of breathing.
What Leo didn't notice was that just now, a very faint gray air escaped from his mouth and nose.
But what he noticed was that a new column had appeared in his panel.
[Breathing Technique: Furnace Breathing Technique Phase 1100]
"You're actually here!" Eve's exclamation came from the door.
Leo didn't notice, but Eve noticed Leo's anger.
